nodes.label: Heartbeat Job Time Budget Rule
nodes.rationale: Derived from mistakes where heartbeat jobs looped without time checks, causing budget overruns.

nodes.label: Hourly Tick Alignment Rule
nodes.rationale: Ensures jobs run on ticks with remaining time and use stable time references (T0) rather than dynamic UTC minutes.

nodes.label: Vercel Env Var Testing Rule
nodes.rationale: Prevents production build failures caused by local tests passing against live environment variables that differ from Vercel's.

nodes.label: Alert Deduplication Rule
nodes.rationale: Prevents multiple Vercel instances from posting duplicate alerts by using a claim-and-verify pattern.

nodes.label: System Alert Persistence Rule
nodes.rationale: Uses AGENT LOG instead of in-memory flags to ensure alerts aren't repeated across Vercel cold starts.

nodes.label: Error Truncation Safety Rule
nodes.rationale: Ensures root causes are at the front of error strings because api/inbox.js and api/leads.js truncate to 300 characters.

nodes.label: AI Fallback Reporting Rule
nodes.rationale: Requires keeping the original provider's error (e.g., Claude) even if the fallback (e.g., Gemini) also fails.

nodes.label: Test Bank Timeout Rule
nodes.rationale: Manages Vercel's 300s execution limit by stopping new cases at 170s and capping individual cases at 55s.

nodes.label: Idempotent Posting Rule
nodes.rationale: Prevents duplicate external communications (Discord, WhatsApp) by avoiding retry loops for sending hooks.

nodes.label: AI Outage Notification Rule
nodes.rationale: Ensures immediate notification to Harsh for spend limits while preserving state (unread emails) for later processing.
